text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature achieved great results with a 
run that left a lasting impression on the 
crowd. She made up her mind to become even 
stronger by the time Tokai Teio returned.

On the way home—her Trainer hands her a 
handmade origami trophy to celebrate her 
being able to run the race at her own 
pace.

Furthermore, believing that she was now 
ready for the Arima Kinen, the Trainer 
proposed entering the race.

To repay the fans who supported her, Nice 
Nature took up the suggestion and decided 
to enter the Arima Kinen.
